details.description: Implement idempotency keys for payment callbacks to prevent race conditions
details.engineering_notes: Implement idempotency using payment gateway transaction ID + timestamp hash. Add lock on booking creation during callback processing. Implement retry with idempotency check for failed callbacks.

details.description: Implement domain-specific rate limiting for partner invitation emails
details.engineering_notes: Implement per-domain rate limiting using token bucket algorithm. Add delivery status tracking with webhook callbacks. Configure retry with exponential backoff per domain. Need to update email template rendering for partner onboarding.

details.description: Update Salesforce field mappings for API v58.0 compatibility
details.engineering_notes: Salesforce Summer 25 API update changed Account object field paths for partner hierarchy. Need to update field mapping configuration and add API version compatibility tests. Implement feature flag for gradual rollout.

details.description: Reconnect booking confirmation service to payment gateway callback
details.engineering_notes: Payment gateway changed callback URL format in their latest API version. Need to update webhook endpoint configuration and add retry logic with idempotency keys. Also need to add webhook health monitoring.

details.description: Migrate webhook delivery from in-memory to Redis stream-backed persistent queue
details.engineering_notes: Replace in-memory ConcurrentLinkedQueue with Redis Streams. Implement consumer groups for parallel processing. Add dead-letter stream for failed deliveries after max retries.

details.description: Distributed locking implementation for CRM contact record operations
details.engineering_notes: Implement Redis-based distributed locks for contact record operations. Add deadlock detection with automatic retry. Need to handle lock expiry and cleanup for stuck transactions.

details.description: Emergency patch for portfolio aggregation pipeline memory leak
details.engineering_notes: Root cause identified as unbounded result set in portfolio aggregation query. Memory usage grows linearly with portfolio count. Need to implement cursor-based pagination and streaming aggregation.
